observations: A single motorcycle tyre held by a hand.
The tread pattern consists of deep, angular grooves and small circular indentations.
The tyre sidewall is not visible in the photo.
The background shows a tiled floor and a watermark for 'CENOCAUTOS'.
The tyre appears to be a standard road-use model.

claims.evidence: The photo shows the tread but cannot measure the remaining depth.
The sidewalls and the inner lining are not shown.
No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The tyre may be expired (old stock).
risks.proof: A clear photo of the manufacture or expiry date code on the sidewall.

risks.risk: The tyre may have been repaired (patched).
risks.proof: A photo of the sidewall showing the patch location and the patch itself.

risks.risk: The tyre may have a structural bulge or damage not visible in the photo.
risks.proof: A photo of the tyre lying flat on a surface to check for sidewall bulges.

risks.risk: The tyre may be a different brand or size than the one claimed.
risks.proof: A photo of the sidewall showing the brand name and the 4-digit size code.

proof_requests: Photo of the sidewall showing the brand name and the 4-digit size code (e.g., 120/70R12).
Photo of the manufacture or expiry date code on the sidewall.
Photo of the tyre lying flat to check for sidewall bulges.
Photo of the patch location if the tyre has been repaired.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
